reveal_en: Plants don't have ears, but they can "hear" the vibrations of caterpillars chewing on their leaves. They then boost their chemical defenses, preparing for the attack before significant damage occurs.
reveal_zh: 植物虽无耳，却能“听见”毛毛虫啃食叶片的振动。它们随即增强化学防御，在受损前就做好反击准备。
meaning_en: This reveals a hidden layer of sensory awareness in the natural world, challenging our anthropocentric understanding of perception.
meaning_zh: 这揭示了自然界中隐藏的感官意识，挑战了我们以人类为中心对感知的理解。

visual.motion: Subtle vibrations rippling across a leaf surface.
